# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple platform and WinUI fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple OS 26.0 TFM support and a WinUI DLL resolution fix to the 3.x line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple OS 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs backported to 3.x** — The 26.0 library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs introduced in 4.x are now available on the 3.119.x line, enabling consumers targeting the latest Apple platforms to stay on 3.x. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
- **WinUI Projection DLL resolution fixed for .NET 9 consumers** — An error where the WinUI Projection DLL was not found at runtime on .NET 9 has been resolved, restoring WinUI app compatibility on 3.119.x. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
